title: Xin-Fu-Kang oral liquid mitigates chronic heart failure through NR4A1-Dependent regulation of endoplasmic reticulum-mitochondrial crosstalk in Cardiomyocytes.
authors: Zhang, Xiaohan; Chang, Xing; Chai, Ruoning; Zhang, Xuesong; Li, Jiaran; Guo, Zezhen; Qiu, Zhiling; Song, Yuguo; Shi, Shuqing; Hu, Yuanhui; Du, Bai
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方XFK通过NR4A1调控心肌细胞线粒体-内质网互作缓解心衰，仅用分子对接做初步靶点验证，核心非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic heart failure (CHF) is the terminus of a variety of cardiovascular diseases. Xin-Fu-Kang oral liquid (XFK), a natural herbal compound, has been used in CHF treatment for decades. However, further investigation is required to elucidate the fundamental mechanisms. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: Transverse aortic constriction (TAC) was performed in mouse models. The pharmacological efficacy of XFK was confirmed by assessing cardiac function and the observation of pathological alterations in myocardial tissue. Following this, single-cell sequencing (scRNA-seq) was implemented. With the identification of XFK metabolites in rat serum via UPLC-QE MS, molecular docking was utilized to conduct preliminary validation of putative therapeutic targets. Subsequently, the phenylephrine-induced model of cardiac pressure overload was established for conducting additional verification and rescue experiments by silencing NR4A1 in vitro. RESULTS: XFK intervention significantly ameliorated cardiac function in the TAC-induced CHF model. Based on scRNA-seq, cardiomyocytes exhibited the most notable alterations following XFK intervention, with NR4A1 identified as a significantly differentially expressed gene after both TAC induction and XFK intervention. In vitro experiments demonstrated that XFK enhanced mitochondrial function, mitigated oxidative stress, and restored mitophagy in a NR4A1-dependent manner, consequently decreasing apoptosis in PE-induced H9C2. Furthermore, the upstream mechanism was associated with capacity of XFK to mitigate endoplasmic reticulum stress and regulate crosstalk between the two organelles. CONCLUSION: XFK counteracts cardiac chronic pressure overload through regulating NR4A1-mediated functional interaction between endoplasmic reticulum and mitochondria in cardiomyocytes, further preserves mitochondria function and prevents apoptosis. This finding indicates a novel pharmacological therapy for CHF.
abstract_zh: 背景：慢性心力衰竭（CHF）是多种心血管疾病的终末阶段。心福康口服液（XFK）作为一种天然复方中药，已在CHF治疗中应用数十年。然而，其根本机制仍需进一步研究阐明。研究设计与方法：在小鼠模型中实施横向主动脉缩窄（TAC）手术。通过评估心脏功能和观察心肌组织病理学改变，确认了XFK的药理疗效。随后，进行了单细胞测序（scRNA-seq）。通过UPLC-QE MS鉴定大鼠血清中的XFK代谢物，利用分子对接对推定治疗靶点进行初步验证。此后，建立苯肾上腺素诱导的心脏压力超负荷模型，通过体外沉默NR4A1进行额外验证和拯救实验。结果：XFK干预显著改善了TAC诱导的CHF模型中的心脏功能。基于scRNA-seq，心肌细胞在XFK干预后表现出最显著的变化，NR4A1被鉴定为TAC诱导和XFK干预后均显著差异表达的基因。体外实验表明，XFK以NR4A1依赖性方式增强线粒体功能、减轻氧化应激并恢复线粒体自噬，从而减少PE诱导的H9C2细胞凋亡。此外，上游机制与XFK缓解内质网应激及调节两种细胞器间串扰的能力相关。结论：XFK通过调控心肌细胞中NR4A1介导的内质网与线粒体功能相互作用，对抗心脏慢性压力超负荷，进一步保护线粒体功能并防止凋亡。这一发现为CHF提供了一种新的药物治疗策略。
